task_scope: Previously frozen seed 0 uniform subset of 256 original MedXpertQA Text test questions from 2450, in source order. The five original development questions are used for warmup.

budget.upstream_loop: Original ReAct webthink loop, including its format-retry calls.

restart: Complete block boundaries only. Every new process warms the explicitly listed disjoint development tasks. Block seed is native.seed + block_index + 1. Incomplete attempts remain excluded.
sampling_reproducibility: Fixed task identities, source order and per-block seeds. Sampled predictions need not be bitwise identical when dynamic microbatch arrival order differs.
task_adaptation: One domain-independent multiple-choice instruction is shared across AQuA, SuperGPQA and MedXpertQA. Original ReAct loop, action parser and calculator remain unchanged. Every supplied option ID and description is retained.
